text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun breezed lightly through the 
Kikuka-sho. Taking note of her 
performance, Reporter Otonashi comes by 
for an interview.

In her interview, Mayano Top Gun mentions 
that she has Narita Brian on her mind.

Reporter Otonashi asks her if she intends 
to enter Narita Brian's next race... the 
Arima Kinen.

To face Narita Brian in a direct showdown, 
Mayano Top Gun naturally replies that she 
will enter the race.
